title: Privacy policy (draft)
bodyMd:
## Draft

This is a draft with placeholders. It is not final and the school has not signed off on it. This tool is run by some students form the AT Comp Sci class. It is not run by or affiliated with Pascack Valley Regional High School District.

## What we collect

Your Google account name and email, the grade you pick, the courses you plan, grades you enter yourself, and anything you write in an appeal. We do not store your age or birthdate. We only remember that you said you are 13 or older.

## Eighth graders

If you are an incoming 8th grader, the grades you type in are a self-reported snapshot. We delete them at the end of your first appeal cycle.

## Who sees it

You. Counselors and department supervisors at the school can see plans and appeals they need to review. We do not sell data or show ads.

## Your choices

You can export or delete your data from Settings. Contact: [CONTACT EMAIL].

title: Terms of use (draft)
bodyMd:
## Draft

This is a draft with placeholders. It is not final and the school has not signed off on it.

## What this is

An unofficial tool to plan courses and check graduation credits. It does not place you in courses. The school decides placement from your real records.

## Your part

Enter information honestly. Suggestions made from self-reported answers may be wrong. Check important choices with your counselor.

## No warranty

The tool is provided as is. Course information comes from the Program of Studies and may be out of date. Contact: [CONTACT EMAIL]. Operator: [OPERATOR NAME].
